spans.s:
नेष् नेष्, cl. 1. A. नेषते, निनेषे, &c.,
to go, move.

नेष नेष (fr. rt. 1. नी), forming a super-
lative नेष-तम, occurring in the inst. pl. नेष-
तमैस्, used adverbially in Ṛg-veda

नेषन्, आ or अ, m. or n. (?), Ved. leading, con-
ducting; (Sāy.) नेषणि = नेतव्ये विषये.

नेष्टृ, टा, m. one of the chief officiating priests
at a Soma sacrifice, he who leads forward the wife of
the sacrificer and prepares the Surā. In Ṛg-veda

, Neṣṭṛ is said to be another name of Tvaṣṭṛ
from his having assumed upon some occasion the
function of the Neṣṭṛ priest.

नेष्ट्र, अम्, n. the Soma vessel of the Neṣṭṛ;
the office of the Neṣṭṛ.

नेष्ट्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the Neṣṭṛ
priest, relating to him.

नेष्ट नेष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. न + इष्ट), not
wished for, undesired, disagreeable, unfavourable.
